title: Subsets II
summary: Return each distinct subset of the input multiset, including the empty subset.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–10 integers in [−10, 10]. Equal values are allowed.
contractDetails.output-checking: Require every distinct answer once. The outer order and element order within each answer are free.

statement: Return each distinct subset of the input multiset, including the empty subset. A subset may contain a repeated value up to its input frequency. Order does not distinguish answers.

examples.explanation: There are three allowed counts for 2.
Choose the count of −1 independently of whether 0 is selected.
The singleton and empty subset are both required.

constraints: 1–10 integers in [−10, 10]. Equal values are allowed.
hints: Conceptual: A value that occurs twice may appear zero, one or two times.
Directional: Group equal values, or sort to put them together.
Implementation: When walking sorted indices, skip a repeated value only at the same decision depth.
complexityAnalysis: O(n log n + n·2ⁿ) time as a worst-case bound including output. O(n) auxiliary space.
